svg.title: The ELU Usage tab lists made-up Claude and Codex accounts, each limit as a bar with the percent used and the time left, and a folded account is opened to show all its limits.

g.text: Show your accounts and their plan usage
enter on an account uses it
Type /usage to open the Usage tab.
Each account shows every limit as a bar: used, time left.
A folded account shows only its tightest limit.
f opens it: all the limits of that account.
